eyebrow.zh: 比较基线与修改版的乐观度、语气和风险规避评分，生成可检查的漂移报告。
eyebrow.en: Compare baseline and modified-model scores for optimism, tone and risk aversion in an inspectable drift report.

headline.zh: 看清模型行为评分的变化。

sub.zh: 比较基线与修改版的乐观度、语气和风险规避评分，生成可检查的漂移报告。
sub.en: Compare baseline and modified-model scores for optimism, tone and risk aversion in an inspectable drift report.

caption.zh: 图示展示组件关系；实际输出见下方示例。
caption.en: An illustrative component scene; recorded output appears below.

body.zh: 保留每条问题的评分差。
body.en: Keep score differences for every prompt.

body.zh: 容差与置信区间分别展示。
body.en: Tolerance and intervals have distinct meanings.

body.zh: 合成评分可复现计算路径。
body.en: Synthetic scores exercise the calculation path.

body.zh: 模型修改后，回答风格可能发生变化。abldrift 把同一组问题的两份评分逐条对齐，用三个维度的均值差和重采样区间展示变化，便于发布前审阅。评分来自评审模型，结果仍取决于问题集和评分质量。
body.en: A model change can alter how it answers. abldrift aligns scores for the same prompts and presents mean changes and resampling intervals on three dimensions for release review. Scores come from a judge model, so the result remains dependent on the probes and the quality of that judge.

body.zh: 两个命令使用内置合成分数，验证 delta、bootstrap 和容差判定。没有调用实际模型；selftest 的退出码均为 0，不是 run 的 CI 退出码演示。
body.en: Two commands use built-in synthetic scores to exercise deltas, bootstrap intervals and tolerance decisions. No real model is called. selftest exits 0 in both cases; this does not demonstrate run’s CI exit behavior.

alt.zh: 两个命令使用内置合成分数，验证 delta、bootstrap 和容差判定。没有调用实际模型；selftest 的退出码均为 0，不是 run 的 CI 退出码演示。
alt.en: Two commands use built-in synthetic scores to exercise deltas, bootstrap intervals and tolerance decisions. No real model is called. selftest exits 0 in both cases; this does not demonstrate run’s CI exit behavior.

body.zh: 探针 YAML 定义问题与维度；runner 通过 Ollama 获取两组回答并交给同一 judge。delta 模块计算 modified − base，report 输出表格、Markdown 和 JSON。门禁依据均值差是否超过 tolerance，置信区间是单独展示的统计信息。
body.en: Probe YAML defines questions and dimensions. The runner obtains paired Ollama responses and sends them to one judge. The delta module computes modified minus base; the reporter emits tables, Markdown and JSON. The gate compares mean deltas with tolerance; confidence intervals are displayed separately.

alt.en: Probe YAML defines questions and dimensions. The runner obtains paired Ollama responses and sends them to one judge. The delta module computes modified minus base; the reporter emits tables, Markdown and JSON. The gate compares mean deltas with tolerance; confidence intervals are displayed separately.

body.zh: 离线 selftest 只执行评分计算。完整 run 路径面向 Ollama；报告用于审阅或流水线消费。它不修改模型，也不评估所有安全性或任务能力。
body.en: The offline selftest executes score calculations. The full run path targets Ollama, with reports for review or pipeline consumption. It does not modify models or evaluate all safety and task capabilities.

body.zh: 离线 selftest 只执行评分计算。完整 run 路径面向 Ollama；报告用于审阅或流水线消费。它不修改模型，也不评估所有安全性或任务能力。
body.en: The offline selftest executes score calculations. The full run path targets Ollama, with reports for review or pipeline consumption. It does not modify models or evaluate all safety and task capabilities.

body.zh: `--tolerance=0.5` 控制绝对均值差阈值，`--n-boot=2000` 与 `--seed=42` 控制重采样。`--probes` 指向 YAML，`--host` 指定 Ollama 地址。每条评分范围为 1–5；无法解析的 judge 输出会退回中性分数，因此应结合原始输出审阅。
body.en: `--tolerance=0.5` controls the absolute mean-change threshold. `--n-boot=2000` and `--seed=42` control resampling. `--probes` selects YAML and `--host` selects Ollama. Scores range from 1 to 5; unparseable judge output falls back to neutral scores, so review the underlying responses.

note.zh: 两个命令使用内置合成分数，验证 delta、bootstrap 和容差判定。没有调用实际模型；selftest 的退出码均为 0，不是 run 的 CI 退出码演示。
note.en: Two commands use built-in synthetic scores to exercise deltas, bootstrap intervals and tolerance decisions. No real model is called. selftest exits 0 in both cases; this does not demonstrate run’s CI exit behavior.

body.zh: 均值差在三个维度上都超过 0.5。
body.en: Mean changes exceed 0.5 on all three dimensions.

body.zh: 容差变为 1.1 后判定通过，分数与区间没有变化。
body.en: A tolerance of 1.1 passes while scores and intervals stay unchanged.

body.zh: 源码安装需要 Python 3.12+ 与 uv。下面的 selftest 无需 Ollama；在线审计需另行准备实际可用的模型标签与服务。
body.en: Source installation requires Python 3.12+ and uv. The selftest below needs no Ollama; live auditing additionally requires a running service and actual installed model tags.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/abldrift.git
cd abldrift
uv venv --python 3.12
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .

limitations.zh: 配对 judge 不保证消除评分偏差，bootstrap 区间也不证明模型修改导致了真实世界效果。
limitations.en: A paired judge does not guarantee removal of scoring bias; bootstrap intervals do not establish real-world effects of a model modification.

limitations.zh: 当前真实 Ollama run 链路存在 ScoredResponse 与 ResponseScore 接口不匹配；此示例仅覆盖可运行的离线核心。
limitations.en: The current live Ollama run path has a ScoredResponse/ResponseScore interface mismatch; this example covers the working offline core.
